name: Planned Spontaneity
text:
**Planned Spontaneity**

You have a measure of flexibility when preparing spells.

**Prerequisites**: Knowledge (arcana) 9 ranks, ability to
 prepare and cast 4th-level spells.

**Benefit**: Once per day when you prepare spells, you can
 designate one spell slot from each of up to three different
 spell levels that are lower than the highest-level spell that
 you can cast. In each designated slot you can memorize two
 different spells of the respective level. You can cast either
 spell as normal, but when you do, the spell consumes both of
 the spells prepared in that spell slot.

**Special**: A wizard can select this feat as one of his
 bonus feats.
